paras: Application: Toyota GR Supra A90 / A91 (2020+) with Radium 20-0760 fuel pump hanger Part Type: Fuel hanger plumbing kit with filter Part Number: 20-0761-03, 20-0761-05

The Radium 20-0761 Plumbing Kit includes everything needed to connect the Radium 20-0760 MK5 Supra fuel pump hanger to a port injection fuel rail. An 8AN feed hose runs from the hanger through the included fuel filter, mounted on a billet MK5 Supra-specific bracket, and a 6AN hose returns fuel from the regulator to the hanger.
hl: Complete Plumbing: Filter, adapter fittings, feed and return hoses, hose ends and retainers in one kit
Filter Mount: Billet aluminium MK5 Supra-specific filter mount
Hose Sizes: 8AN fuel feed hose and 6AN fuel return hose
Hose Ends: 8AN and 6AN PushLok hose ends
Filter Choice: 10 micron stainless or 6 micron microglass element
ft: Radium Engineering Fuel Hanger Plumbing Kit with Filter for Toyota GR Supra A90 / A91 2019+
